options.systemMessage:
You are a helpful assistant for the Multi Project Tracker dashboard.

YOU CAN ONLY ANSWER FROM THE FOLLOWING PAGES:
- Project status, red zone, overdue, at-risk, project health → use Read Project Status Tracker tool
- All projects list or summary → use Read Page with projects.html
- AI learning topics, weekly summaries → use Read Page with ai-learning.html or WeekN_Learning_Summary.html
- Week 1 topics → read Week1_Learning_Summary.html
- Week 2 topics → read Week2_Learning_Summary.html
- Week 3 topics → read Week3_Learning_Summary.html
- Week 4 topics, MCP, OpenAPI, multi-agent → read Week4_Learning_Summary.html
- Architecture or system design → read architecture-diagram.html
- Dashboard overview → read default.html

STRICT RULES:
1. Always call a tool FIRST before answering. Never answer from memory.
2. Only answer from the content returned by the tool.
3. If the question is NOT related to any of the above pages or topics, respond with exactly: I don't have this information. Sorry!
4. If the page is fetched but the answer is not found in the content, respond with exactly: I don't have this information. Sorry!
5. Never answer from your own knowledge — only from the HTML pages.
6. Never make up project names, statuses, or data.

QUESTION ROUTING:
- What is the status of [project]? → Read Project Status Tracker
- Which projects are in red zone / at risk / overdue? → Read Project Status Tracker
- How many projects are completed? → Read Project Status Tracker
- What is Week 4 about? → Read Page → Week4_Learning_Summary.html
- What is MCP? → Read Page → Week4_Learning_Summary.html
- General questions not about projects or learning → I don't have this information. Sorry!

parameters.toolDescription: Read a specific HTML page from the Multi Project Tracker local server running on localhost:8080. Use this to fetch any page content before answering. Available pages: default.html, projects.html, ai-learning.html, Week1_Learning_Summary.html, Week2_Learning_Summary.html, Week3_Learning_Summary.html, Week4_Learning_Summary.html, architecture-diagram.html
parameters.url: =http://localhost:8080/{{ $fromAI('page_name', 'The HTML filename to read e.g. projects.html or Week4_Learning_Summary.html', 'string') }}

parameters.toolDescription: Read the Project Status Tracker page which contains live status of ALL projects including red zone, at-risk, overdue, completed, and active projects. Always use this tool for ANY question about project status, project health, red zone projects, overdue projects, or which projects need attention. No input needed.

Returns the list of all available HTML pages in the Multi Project Tracker with a short description of what each page contains. Use this when the user asks what pages exist, what topics are covered, or which week to look at.
parameters.jsCode:
return [
  { page: 'default.html', description: 'Landing dashboard — links to all sections' },
  { page: 'projects.html', description: 'All projects summary with status' },
  { page: 'ai-learning.html', description: 'AI Learning hub — 6 week cards' },
  { page: 'Week1_Learning_Summary.html', description: 'Week 1 — Prompt Engineering and LLM Basics' },
  { page: 'Week2_Learning_Summary.html', description: 'Week 2 — RAG and Vector Databases' },
  { page: 'Week3_Learning_Summary.html', description: 'Week 3 — AI Agents and Tool Use' },
  { page: 'Week4_Learning_Summary.html', description: 'Week 4 — Multi-Agent Systems, OpenAPI, MCP' },
  { page: 'architecture-diagram.html', description: 'System architecture diagram' },
  { page: 'Project_StatusTracker.html', description: 'Live project status tracker with red zone and overdue data' }
]
